messages:
Avery: Kicking off this thread for follow-ups from today's all-hands. Main asks: concrete dates for API streaming rollout, what exact Console metrics are in beta, and when Optimize recommendations (quant + batching) will be available. Keep it short and we'll answer.

Priya: Short bullets: API streaming alpha (low_latency) targeted for May 10th internal alpha; Console per-model metrics beta targeted June 15th with CSV export; Optimize recommendations (early preview) set for late Q3 (Aug) with a focused quantization pilot. I'll post a calendar invite and a one-pager later today.

Marco: Engineering detail: the low_latency streaming path needs the new attention kernel + KV cache tuning. Plan: land kernel to staging by Apr 28, run perf harness, then 2-week internal alpha on Dedicated, followed by controlled customer canary. If kernel lands late, alpha moves by one week.

Sam: DevEx note: SDK will support streaming_mode flags in SDK 1.7 (we bumped to 1.7 to bundle other backpressure fixes). We'll include a streaming example with reconnect/backpressure callbacks and an issues section for common gotchas.

Jordan: For Console beta, can CS see per-customer per-model cost? we need to troubleshoot billing spikes for enterprise customers.

Priya: Yes 1: CS will have a RBAC read-only view showing per-customer per-model token breakdown, route split (chat vs embeddings), and an "estimated monthly spend" column. Audit logs will record access.

Rashmi: Optimize question: will the quant recommendations show an expected quality delta and allow staged rollouts? we need to ensure safe automatic rollbacks.

Marco: Yes  Optimize will provide an expected quality delta with a confidence interval computed from the eval set. Rollouts support traffic-splitting and one-click rollback; we also generate a recommended A/B test config you can apply automatically.

Kai: Any infra cost change if a customer toggles strict low_latency in Console? we should surface a clear estimate.

Priya: We won't auto-bill. Console will show a projected infra delta estimate when you toggle the mode (for Dedicated customers we recommend pool resize; for Hosted we'll show estimated per-token cost delta).

Sam: Quick curl example for the new streaming flag to include in the FAQ draft:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","streaming_mode":"low_latency","input":"List the 3 biggest risks for this rollout."}'
```

Notifier-Bot: Slides + recording: https://internal.redwood/all-hands/2026-04-12. Roadmap one-pager will be attached there when published.

Avery: Action items recap: Priya publishes calendar + one-pager today, Marco posts canary runbook and perf matrix by EOD Thu, Sam opens SDK 1.7 PR with docs, Jordan drafts customer comms + opt-in FAQ, Rashmi to coordinate Optimize pilot customers. Please reply here with a 1-line ack when you start. Closing thread after acknowledgements.
